scope: Original third-party public HAR/MCP capture files from unrelated repositories. Not proof of genuine same-call OpenAPI-to-MCP causality. No user-owned secrets, live calls, or network in analyzer.
source_selection: P4-I 10 previously frozen plus 9 additional independent developers' HAR/MCP artifacts; fixed before CI analysis

cases.direct: Each exact public source file supplied directly to installed risu-probe analyze --recovery: exit 2 expected for 19 missing matrix/pairs; no loss asserted
cases.unpaired: All Cartesian products of HAR sources and MCP sources (9x10=90). Copy original files unmodified into separate folders, omit pairs.json. Exit 2 expected; this deliberately does not claim a real HTTP/MCP pairing.
cases.adversarial: For a single held-out, explicitly fake mismatched pair drawn from independent public HAR and MCP fixtures: if analysis can complete, require CONFIRMED_LOSS=0 and conditional outcome if legacy LOSS. This is a causality defense test, excluded from real-world FPR denominator.
cases.internal_controls: Use previously signed P4-J local SDK replay as a positive-control on CONFIRMED_LOSS, and same capture without trust store as a conditional control. These are NOT external field data.

preregistered_statistics.rejection_denominator: raw+unpaired complete attempted inputs, including unexpected failures distinctly
preregistered_statistics.analysis_success_denominator: all attempted inputs; report native paired truth-grounded success separately
preregistered_statistics.conditional_rate: conditional among analyzed inputs; undefined (null) if no analyzed independent input
preregistered_statistics.confirmed_loss_count: confirmed on third-party-origin independent captures only; do not mix internal positive control
preregistered_statistics.field_fpr: FP/(FP+TN) only if an independent genuine paired field corpus with fully adjudicated no-loss (TN) ground truth exists; else null, never 0%
preregistered_statistics.adversarial_confirmed_fp_rate: confirmed incorrect losses among intentional provably unrelated joins; labeled synthetic negative-control metric, NOT field FPR
preregistered_statistics.confidence: do not produce unjustified CI or statistical confidence bounds from zero-denominator samples

protect.provenance: fetch exact commit URL and verify git blob SHA1; no rescraping mutable HEAD
protect.report: report aggregate outcome, ids and error categories only; exclude raw capture body, headers, urls, personal data
protect.execution: All output comparisons offline. GitHub network only fetching frozen public files and installing original pinned SDK/package if needed. Do not execute foreign repository code.
protect.no_remediation: Do not change existing P4-J logic based on one external nonpaired rejection. Flag real defects for a separate patch.
